media.title: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Studios, Culver City — street view
media.description: Undated historical street view of the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer studio complex in Culver City, the studio associated with Kaper’s Hollywood career.
media.altText: Black-and-white street view of the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer studio complex in Culver City, with parked cars, a long colonnaded building and the MGM rooftop sign.
media.publicCaption: Street view of the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer studio complex in Culver City, showing the studio buildings and rooftop MGM sign. Undated historical photograph.
media.publicCreditLine: City of Culver City, Culver City Historic Images; photographer and date unidentified.
media.rightsNote: The City of Culver City’s historic-image page supplies this photograph without a date, photographer credit or reuse licence. Copyright status therefore remains undetermined. The 740 × 522 pixel image is reproduced without enlargement for non-commercial scholarly identification and discussion of the MGM studio site associated with Kaper’s Hollywood career. The City of Culver City is credited and linked as the immediate institutional source.

places.publicNote: Historic MGM studio complex in Culver City associated with Kaper's MGM career and Hollywood film work. The marker represents the studio site as a whole; the surviving evidence does not identify a particular stage, office or entrance for the linked events.
